comments.content: Unused import `match` from `assert`. This appears to be leftover from debugging and should be removed.

The `matchMethod` handling silently treats unknown match methods as no-match (returns 500). Previously the code logged the match attempt. Consider logging when `matchMethod` is unrecognized, and also note that `payload.includes` will throw if `payload` is not a string (e.g., object/array from JSON).

`dockerResponse.status` is assigned twice: first to `404` (a number) then to `false`. The first assignment is a bug — it should be `dockerResponse.code = 404`. As written, `status` briefly holds a number before being overwritten, and `code` is never set on the ambiguous-match path.

This migration is not idempotent in a safe way: it multiplies any value `< 1` by 100 on every startup. If a user intentionally sets a threshold below 1 (e.g., 0.5 meaning 0.5%), it will be silently rewritten. More importantly, if the migration partially fails and is re-run, already-migrated values (now >= 1) are skipped, but any value that was legitimately < 1 will be re-multiplied. Consider tracking migration completion in a dedicated collection, or using a sentinel/version field.

`runMigrations` is awaited in `MongoDB.connect` but errors from individual migrations are swallowed (each returns true/false without throwing). If a migration fails, the app continues silently. Consider surfacing failures or at least logging at error level so operators notice.

Changing the default from `0.6` to `60` is a breaking semantic change (fraction -> percent). Ensure all consumers of `statusWindowThreshold` (e.g., `statusService.js`) treat it as a percentage. The comparison in `statusService.js` was changed from `<=` to `<`, which combined with the new default may subtly alter recovery behavior — please confirm this is intentional.

`GetTooltip` is a React component that calls `useTheme()` but is invoked as a plain function inside `DataTable` (`config.tooltipContent(row)`). Calling a hook outside of a component render will violate the Rules of Hooks and can cause runtime errors or incorrect theme values. Either convert `GetTooltip` to a hook-free function that receives the theme, or render it as a component (e.g., `<GetTooltip row={row} />`) inside the Tooltip `title`.

Wrapping every `TableRow` in a `Tooltip` will render a tooltip for every row even when `tooltipContent` is null/undefined, which adds unnecessary DOM/popper overhead and can interfere with row click handlers. Consider conditionally rendering the Tooltip only when `config.tooltipContent` is provided.

The new regex allows a leading `/` via `(\/+)?` but the subsequent alternatives don't account for that slash being stripped before matching the name/ID portion. Also, the `[a-f0-9]{12,64}` branch only matches lowercase hex, while Docker short IDs are typically lowercase hex — that's fine — but the name branch `[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_.-]*[a-zA-Z0-9]` requires at least 2 characters, rejecting single-character container names. Verify this is intended.
